tncqnpcp.variantName: My Christmas 7ft Slim Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 210 LED Lights - Green
tncqnpcp.sourceDescription: Bring festive style to your home with this slim pencil Christmas tree, designed to create a traditional Christmas display while taking up minimal floor space. Made with 1,050 green PVC tips, it offers a full, realistic appearance and is designed for repeated seasonal use. The tree is pre-lit with 210 dual-colour LED lights, providing warm white and cool white illumination to suit different festive styles. Choose from 9 lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash, Steady On and Off, using the included remote control to customise your display. A sturdy metal stand provides stability, while the simple assembly and disassembly make the tree convenient to store and reuse year after year. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes, it is suitable for a variety of festive spaces. Specifications: Made from green PVC with 1,050 branch tips and 210 warm white and cool white LED lights. Features 9 lighting modes and an included remote control. Supplied with a sturdy metal stand. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes. Dimensions: Available heights 4ft (122 cm), 5ft (152 cm), 6ft (183 cm) and 7ft (213 cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

sfjzp0qs.sourceDescription: Tired of sparse, artificial-looking holiday trees that wobble and drop messy needles? Featuring 751 main branch tips, its realistic PE foliage offers a soft, authentic touch and lush fullness without the clean-up. k9bwfhn7.baseName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Woodland Berry
k9bwfhn7.variantName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Woodland Berry
k9bwfhn7.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom

9aby15w1.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree skirt helps hide your bare Christmas tree stand. So you can put ornaments and presents on it for decoration. This Christmas tree base featuring a non-woven fabric on the back and thick faux fur on the front is smooth and comfortable, adding a warm touch to your house. The tree skirt sits elegantly at the base of your Christmas tree, making it the perfect spot for placing and unboxing presents. This tree decoration also has long-lasting durability, so you can use it as a home carpet or store it for next year. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: 360 gsm faux fur Diameter: 150 cm Middle hole diameter: 10 cm With non-woven backing This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. ne4bm6rv.sourceDescription: Christmas made extra fun? Yes please. Do it, this season and beyond, with this Outsunny inflatable snowman with a dog. The polyester shell makes this a tough piece, which is also IP44 rated for mild water resistance - it's suitable for use in mild rain outdoors. Inside there is a white LED light and a rotating colorful light - this inflatable snowman glows and sparkles to bring the night alive, this season and beyond. ● Great design for Christmas: Snowman with a dog ● Inner white LED light and rotating colorful light to glow at night ● Plug into the mains to inflate and set up. Turn off to deflate ● IP44 rated polyester shell is safe in mild rain. Suitable for outdoor use ● Four ground stakes, two guy ropes and a sandbag included to pin and stabilise to the ground Primary Colour: White Type: Inflatable Snowman with Dog Material: Polyester Cloth Overall Dimension: 139W x 70D x 188Hcm Overall Height: 6.2ft Cord Length: 3(m) LED Light Count: 1 (Normal), 1 (Rotating) LED Light Power: 0.5W (Normal), 2W (Rotating) Fan: DC 12V, 0.8A Input Voltage: AC 220-240V, 50/60Hz Output Voltage: DC 12V, 1.25A Certification: IP44 Item Label: 844-959V70WT NOTE: Blower needs to be plugged in to keep outdoor Christmas decoration full. Do not leave plugged in for more than eight hours. Do not use in heavy rain, snow or wind Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision.
